n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

maxn = 505
C = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
f = [0] * maxn
h = [0] * maxn
g = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
t = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]

C[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod

f[0] = 1
h[0] = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, i):
        f[i] = (f[i] + f[i - 1 - j] * f[j] % mod * (i + 1) % mod * C[i - 1][j] % mod) % mod

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, i):
        term1 = f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % mod * C[i - 1][j] % mod
        term2 = ((j + 1) * j // 2 + (i - 1 - j) * (i - j) // 2) % mod
        h[i] = (h[i] + term1 * term2) % mod
        h[i] = (h[i] + C[i - 1][j] * (i + 1) % mod * f[i - 1 - j] % mod * h[j]) % mod
        h[i] = (h[i] + C[i - 1][j] * (i + 1) % mod * f[j] % mod * h[i - 1 - j]) % mod

g[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, i + 1):
        g[i][j] = g[i - 1][j]
        for l in range(1, j + 1):
            g[i][j] = (g[i][j] + C[j][l] * g[i - 1 - l][j - l] % mod * g[l][l]) % mod
    g[i][i] = f[i]

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, i + 1):
        t[i][j] = t[i - 1][j]
        for l in range(1, j + 1):
            t[i][j] = (t[i][j] + C[j][l] * t[i - 1 - l][j - l] % mod * f[l]) % mod
            t[i][j] = (t[i][j] + C[j][l] * h[l] % mod * g[i - 1 - l][j - l]) % mod
    t[i][i] = h[i]

print(t[n][m])
